diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
index 451ec9620226..3b71d21cc944 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
@@ -2251,6 +2251,14 @@ int drm_crtc_vblank_start_timer(struct drm_crtc *crtc)
 	vtimer->interval = ns_to_ktime(vblank->framedur_ns);
 	spin_unlock_irqrestore(&vtimer->interval_lock, flags);
 
+	/*
+	 * If the frame duration is 0 (e.g. dotclock is 0) or too large
+	 * (larger than the timeout in drm_wait_one_vblank), the vblank
+	 * timer either won't start or won't fire in time.
+	 */
+	if (!vblank->framedur_ns || vblank->framedur_ns > 100000000)
+		return -EINVAL;
+
 	hrtimer_start(&vtimer->timer, vtimer->interval, HRTIMER_MODE_REL);
 
 	return 0;
